booking.title: Book an Appointment
booking.intro: Choose how you would like to book your appointment – by phone or conveniently online.
booking.call_desc: Call us during opening hours. We will advise you personally and find a suitable time together.
booking.online_desc: Book your preferred time directly online. The appointment is added to our practice calendar automatically.
booking.legal_text: By booking online you arrange a binding appointment. In the event of a no-show or a cancellation made less than 24 hours in advance, we reserve the right to charge for the time reserved or a missed-appointment fee.
booking.consent_label: I acknowledge that this booking is binding and chargeable.
booking.pending_text: Online appointment booking will be available shortly. In the meantime, please arrange your appointment by phone.
